asks: Keep Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West as two urban ridings with minimal change; do not divide and hybridize them with rural areas.

quote: I write to you today to voice my support and appreciation for the recommendations of the Electoral Boundary Commission to only minimally adjust the electoral boundaries of the Lethbridge East, and Lethbridge West ridings. I am aware of a proposal to divide and hybridize these electoral districts into multiple new urban/rural districts, and I am emphatically opposed to that suggestion.

asks: Keep the proposed Mackenzie and Edmonton-West-Enoch ridings in the final report for Indigenous representation.

note: Supports the interim Mackenzie riding (the K2 vehicle) for Indigenous representation, but never names Lesser Slave Lake or its dissolution; coded narrowly as mention only (rule 17).

asks: Extend Calgary-North West to include Rocky View communities such as Church Ranches, Bearspaw and Watermark.

note: Cochrane named only as the end of a bike path; nothing about whom Cochrane shares a district with.

asks: Keep the St. Albert and St. Albert-Sturgeon boundaries as in the interim report, and apply the one-urban, one-hybrid model to smaller cities like Airdrie and Medicine Hat.

quote: I hope that you will keep this part of the map the same in the Final Report
note: Also: 'the approach of having one urban riding and one hybrid riding makes the most sense for now'.

quote: it breaks up Medicine Hat and Airdrie into two hybrid ridings in a way that isn't fair to the voters in those cities. The St. Albert approach should be applied to all of the cities smaller than Lethbridge and Red Deer
note: Wants the St. Albert model for Airdrie: one Airdrie-only urban district plus one hybrid (on no map).
Red Deer named only as a comparison (rule 6).
Lethbridge named only as a comparison (rule 6).

asks: Keep Montgomery in Calgary-Bow rather than adding it to Calgary-Varsity.
Do not dissolve the Lesser Slave Lake riding; reconsider a section 15(2) exemption for it and reconsider the Mackenzie, Peace River-Notley and Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca proposals.

quote: We urge you to work with our region as a whole and with the communities within it to get a better understanding of our riding before you make recommendations that dissolve us into larger ridings that surround us.
note: Also p. 130: 'request that the Commission reconsider this exemption for the Lesser Slave River riding'; objects to Mackenzie and Slave Lake-Athabasca-Westlock proposals.

asks: Keep the Lethbridge-East riding urban; do not hybridize it with rural areas.

quote: I appreciate that my urban riding remain urban. I do not support hybridizing my riding with rural areas.
note: Header: Lethbridge-East. Rejects any hybridization of her riding, which covers the four-way plan and lesser joinings.

asks: Adopt the interim Calgary-Glenmore boundaries in the final report.
Expresses appreciation for the interim report's recommendations for Lethbridge-East.

quote: I have read the interim report for this area and I appreciate the work put into it and the recommendations within it.
note: Header: Lethbridge-East. Approval of the interim recommendations for the area, which keep two urban Lethbridge seats (rule 5); not specific.

asks: Do not delete rural ridings (the northern Slave Lake riding) or combine rural with urban ridings; add more urban ridings instead.

quote: However, it's curious that the northern riding being eliminated is the one that is represented by an independent conservative MLA
note: Header names Slave Lake. Request: 'Do not delete rural ridings, and do not combine them with urban ridings.'

asks: Keep Airdrie's ridings strictly within the city's municipal boundaries, not lumped in with neighbouring rural communities.

quote: I want to write to you about the need to keep Airdrie's ridings strictly within their municipal boundaries. If Airdrie is lumped in together with neighbouring rural communities, our representation won't be reflective of the Airdrie that I'm so proud to be from.
note: Header: Airdrie-East. Rejects the interim joining of Airdrie with rural areas.

asks: Do not put Beaumont in the same constituency as Strathcona County.
Review growth projections for Edmonton's urban core so densification is reflected; supports a new southeast Edmonton riding.
Supports the proposed Calgary-Glenmore boundary including Kingsland.
Do not put Beaumont in the Strathcona-Sherwood Park constituency; keep Strathcona County with Sherwood Park.
Retain the Edmonton-Riverview riding if possible and keep variances close to parity; resist partisan proposals.
Give Edmonton and Calgary the proposed new seats and possibly another for Edmonton, reconsider combining Riverview and Glenora, and avoid merging urban and rural ridings.
Thanks the commission for the interim report and accepts the Edmonton-Mill Woods name; no change requested.
Reconsider dividing Parkland County among four mostly urban ridings and keep the county more intact.
Keep two Grande Prairie ridings, one urban and one mixed rural, with a small urban portion in Grande Prairie-Wapiti.
Keep Spruce Grove out of Edmonton ridings, restore Stony Plain with Spruce Grove, and do not reduce Edmonton's seats.
Keep municipal boundaries honoured with no hybrid ridings, add a further seat each to Edmonton and Calgary, and maintain Riverview.
Keep the Town of Coaldale in its current provincial electoral district.

note: Coaldale letter; Lethbridge named as the regional service hub only. Does not ask for Coaldale to share a district with part of the city (rule 8).

asks: Keep electoral variance to five per cent, add a seat each to Edmonton and Calgary, and keep Edmonton-Strathcona together.
Keep Lethbridge as two electoral ridings within the city boundaries, as in the interim report.

quote: I support the interim recommendation that Lethbridge stays as 2 electoral ridings with the boundaries in the city.
note: Rejection: 'Having more than 2 electoral riding within Lethbridge is no needed at all.' Read as rejecting a split of the city among more ridings (the four-way plan); medium on the reject.

asks: Agrees with the interim report keeping Lethbridge urban with the small London Road adjustment; do not carve up Lethbridge onto rural areas.

quote: Thank you again for not carving up Lethbridge and tacking us onto rural areas.
note: Also: 'I agree with your interim report. Thank you for giving thoughtful decision making to keeping Lethbridge urban.'

asks: Give Medicine Hat its own representation rather than splitting it and combining it with rural areas.
Reconsider the large Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca riding and keep a constituency similar in size to Athabasca-Barrhead-Westlock; do not consolidate northern ridings from seven to six.

note: Objects to the interim Slave Lake-Westlock-Athabasca riding and to cutting northern ridings from seven to six (the change that dissolved Lesser Slave Lake), but speaks for Athabasca-Barrhead-Westlock and never names Lesser Slave Lake; coded narrowly as mention only (rule 17).

asks: Reject the proposed Calgary-Confluence division and add a new district in south and southeast Calgary instead.
Supports the proposed Banff-Jasper riding and suggests Canmore be added to its name.
Keep Lethbridge as two electoral ridings within the city boundaries, as in the interim report.

quote: I support the interim recommendation that Lethbridge stays as 2 electoral ridings with the boundaries in the city.
note: Near-identical wording to EBC-2025-2-1119 in its first sentence.

asks: Set aside both Calgary options and start again: add a new south Calgary seat and do not combine rural towns such as Okotoks with Calgary.
Keep Edmonton-North West as currently drawn, without adding Calder.
Keep the Strathcona County area north of Highway 16 in Fort Saskatchewan-Vegreville as proposed.
Supports the modest changes to Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood and asks for one or two new Edmonton ridings that keep communities together.
Agrees with the proposed Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West changes and asks that Lethbridge not be divided further into hybrid divisions.

quote: I feel that the Lethbridge electorate as a community of interest is quite distinct from our surrounding rural neighbours and that proper representation would not be served for either electorate by dividing Lethbridge up further.
note: Also: 'I believe the proposed change to these two electoral divisions make sense and I agree with them.'

asks: Supports the new Edmonton-Decore boundaries but asks the commission to reconsider scrapping Edmonton-Riverview.
Reconsider the interim redrawing that separates the First Nations west of Rocky Mountain House from the Rocky Mountain House constituency.

quote: By excluding them from the Rocky Mountain House, constituency you will be disenfranchising them from reasonable access to their elected MLA!! This is unconscionable. As a Rocky Mountain house resident I resent and totally disagree on this redrawing of our electoral area.
note: Header: current Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre; about Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House. Objects to the interim split that sends the three First Nations west of Rocky (western Clearwater County) to another riding; read as wanting the Rocky area and its western neighbours kept together. Says nothing of Sundre or Lacombe, so W0 direction, not W1.

asks: Keep the current Lethbridge-East and Lethbridge-West boundaries and add an additional seat in Lethbridge rather than joining city and rural voters.

quote: By maintaining the current boundaries, and adding an additional seat in Lethbridge to reflect our growing population, we can continue to meet each the unique needs of both rural and city without pitting us against one another.
note: Wants the current urban-only design kept and a third seat added in Lethbridge (no listed option; urban-only, so closer to L1 than L2). Also: 'Forcing disparate groups into one riding serves neither group' (general, not coded as a rejection).

asks: Keep Jasper in West Yellowhead rather than dividing it from its surrounding area.
Keep Calgary-Shaw a fully urban riding within the stated boundaries and do not combine it with Okotoks.
Keep Beaumont whole in Leduc-Beaumont rather than split along 50th Street, and leave Heritage Hills in Strathcona-Sherwood Park.
Municipality of Jasper council supports naming the proposed district Canmore-Banff-Jasper.
Keep 13th Street as the Lethbridge-East/West dividing line (leave London Road in Lethbridge-West) and do not divide Lethbridge into three or four blended rural-urban ridings.

quote: I do not support the notion that Lethbridge should be divided into three or four blended rural-urban style ridings.
note: Wants two city ridings split at 13th Street (p. 88: 'The dividing line between the West and East ridings in Lethbridge has always been 13th Street'), objecting to the interim move of London Road-Fleetwood to Lethbridge-East; the east-west line is a within-city detail outside the option table.

asks: Set aside both Calgary options, add a new constituency in south Calgary, and avoid combining towns such as Okotoks with Calgary.
Do not change the Lethbridge electoral boundaries or add rural areas to urban ridings.

quote: By proposing to change the electoral boundaries to include more rural representation in Urban areas you dilute the urban voice and skew representation towards the UCP.
note: Request: 'DO NOT Change the Lethbridge electoral boundaries!!!' The writer attributes a hybrid proposal to the commission; read as wanting Lethbridge's two urban seats kept and rejecting any city-country joining.

asks: Place the Town of Devon in an Edmonton-South West-Devon district.
Allocate any new Calgary seat to south Calgary rather than central Calgary.
Keep the Calgary-Varsity boundary the same, without adding Montgomery.
